starting-out.speaker: Father Aereck
starting-out.text: Welcome to the church of holy Saradomin.

steps.player: I'm looking for a quest.

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: That's lucky, I need someone to do a quest for me.

steps.player: Okay, let me help then.

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: Thank you. The problem is, there is a ghost in the church graveyard. I would like you to get rid of it.

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: If you need any help, my friend Father Urhney is an expert on ghosts.

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: I believe he is currently living as a hermit in Lumbridge swamp. He has a little shack in the far west of the swamps.

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: Exit the graveyard through the south gate to reach the swamp. I'm sure if you told him that I sent you he'd be willing to help.

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: My name is Father Aereck by the way. Pleased to meet you.

steps.player: Likewise.

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: Take care travelling through the swamps, I have heard they can be quite dangerous.

steps.player: I will, thanks.
Sorry, I don't have time right now.

steps.speaker: Father Aereck
steps.text: Oh well. If you do have some spare time on your hands, come back and talk to me.

starting-out-talking-to-father-aereck-ag.speaker: Father Aereck
starting-out-talking-to-father-aereck-ag.text: Have you got rid of the ghost yet?

starting-out-talking-to-father-aereck-ag.player: I can't find Father Urhney at the moment.

starting-out-talking-to-father-aereck-ag.speaker: Father Aereck
starting-out-talking-to-father-aereck-ag.text: Well, you can get to the swamp he lives in by going south through the cemetery.

starting-out-talking-to-father-aereck-ag.speaker: Father Aereck
starting-out-talking-to-father-aereck-ag.text: You'll have to go right into the far western depths of the swamp, near the coastline. That is where his house is.

steps.player: Well, that's friendly.

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: I SAID go AWAY.

steps.player: Okay, okay... sheesh, what a grouch.

options.text: Father Aereck sent me to talk to you.

steps.player: Father Aereck sent me to talk to you.

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: I suppose I'd better talk to you then. What problems has he got himself into this time?

options.text: He's got a ghost haunting his graveyard.

steps.player: He's got a ghost haunting his graveyard.

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: Oh, the silly fool.

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: I leave town for just five months, and ALREADY he can't manage.

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: (sigh)

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: Well, I can't go back and exorcise it. I vowed not to leave this place. Until I had done a full two years of prayer and meditation.

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: Tell you what I can do though; take this amulet.
Father Urhney hands you an amulet.

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: It is an Amulet of Ghostspeak.

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: So called, because when you wear it you can speak to ghosts. A lot of ghosts are doomed to be ghosts because they have left some important task uncompleted.

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: Maybe if you know what this task is, you can get rid of the ghost. I'm not making any guarantees mind you, but it is the best I can do right now.

steps.player: Thank you. I'll give it a try!

options.text: You mean he gets himself into lots of problems?

steps.player: You mean he gets himself into lots of problems?

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: Yeah. For example, when we were trainee priests he kept on getting stuck up bell ropes.

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: Anyway. I don't have time for chitchat. What's his problem THIS time?

steps.player: He's got a ghost haunting his graveyard.

options.text: I've come to repossess your house.

steps.player: I've come to repossess your house.

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: Under what grounds???

steps.player: Repeated failure on mortgage repayments.

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: What?

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: But... I don't have a mortgage! I built this house myself!

steps.player: Sorry. I must have got the wrong address. All the houses look the same around here.

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: What? What houses? What ARE you talking about???

steps.player: Never mind.

options.text: I don't know. I just wanted this house.

steps.player: I don't know. I just wanted this house...

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: Oh... go away and stop wasting my time!

talking-to-father-urhney-talking-to-fath.speaker: Father Aereck
talking-to-father-urhney-talking-to-fath.text: Have you got rid of the ghost yet?

talking-to-father-urhney-talking-to-fath.player: I had a talk with Father Urhney. He has given me this funny amulet to talk to the ghost with.

talking-to-father-urhney-talking-to-fath.speaker: Father Aereck
talking-to-father-urhney-talking-to-fath.text: I always wondered what that amulet was... Well, I hope it's useful. Tell me when you get rid of the ghost!

options.text: I've lost the Amulet of Ghostspeak.

steps.player: I've lost the Amulet of Ghostspeak.

steps.text: Father Urhney signs.
If they player currently has it in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: What are you talking about? I can see you've got it with you!
If the amulet if stored in a bank, Death's Office, Item Retrieval Service:

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: You come here wasting my time... Has it even occurred to you that you've got it stored somewhere? Now GO AWAY!
If the player does not have inventory space:

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: How careless can you get? Those things aren't easy to come by you know! Now clear some space in your inventory and I'll give you another one.
If the player has inventory space:

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: How careless can you get? Those things aren't easy to come by you know! It's a good job I've got a spare.
Father Urhney hands you an amulet.
ghostspeak amulet

steps.speaker: Father Urhney
steps.text: Be more careful this time.

steps.player: Okay, I'll try to be.

steps.text: Woo wooo. Woooooooooooooooooo!

steps.player: Did he really?

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Woo.

options.text: My brother had EXACTLY the same problem.

steps.player: My brother had EXACTLY the same problem.

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Woo Wooooo!

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Wooooo Woo woo woo!

options.text: You'll have to give me the recipe some time...

steps.player: You'll have to give me the recipe some time...

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Wooooooo woo woooooooo.

options.text: Hmm... I'm not so sure about that.

steps.player: Yeah, that's what I thought.

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Wooo woooooooooooooo...

steps.player: Goodbye. Thanks for the chat.

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Wooo wooo?

options.text: Hmm I'm not sure about that.
Any hints where I can find some treasure?

steps.player: Any hints where I can find some treasure?

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Wooooooo woo! Wooooo woo wooooo woowoowoo woo Woo wooo. Wooooo woo woo? Woooooooooooooooooo!

options.text: Thank you. You've been very helpful.

steps.player: Thank you. You've been very helpful.

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Wooooooo.

talking-to-the-restless-ghost-while-wear.speaker: Restless ghost
talking-to-the-restless-ghost-while-wear.text: Did you just understand what I said???

options.text: Yep, now tell me what the problem is.

steps.player: Yep, now tell me what the problem is.

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: WOW! This is INCREDIBLE! I didn't expect anyone to ever understand me again!

steps.player: Ok, Ok, I can understand you!
But have you any idea WHY you're doomed to be a ghost?

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Well, to be honest... I'm not sure.

steps.player: I've been told a certain task may need to be completed so you can rest in peace.

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: I should think it is probably because a warlock has come along and stolen my skull. If you look inside my coffin there, you'll find my corpse without a head on it.

steps.player: Do you know where this warlock might be now?

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: I think it was one of the warlocks who lives in the big tower by the sea south-west from here.

steps.player: Ok. I will try and get the skull back for you, then you can rest in peace.

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Ooh, thank you. That would be such a great relief!

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: It is so dull being a ghost...

options.text: No, you sound like you're speaking nonsense to me.

steps.player: No, you sound like you're speaking nonsense to me.

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Oh that's a pity. You got my hopes up there.

steps.player: Yeah, it is a pity. Sorry about that.

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Hang on a second... you CAN understand me!

steps.player: No I can't.

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Great. The first person I can speak to in ages...and they're a moron.

steps.player: Yep, clever aren't I?

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: I'm impressed. You must be very powerful. I don't suppose you can stop me being a ghost?

options.text: Yes, ok. Do you know WHY you're a ghost?

steps.player: Yes, ok. Do you know WHY you're a ghost?

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Nope. I just know I can't do much of anything like this!

steps.player: No, you're scary!

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Great.

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: The first person I can speak to in ages...

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: ..and they're an idiot.

steps.player: Wow, this amulet works!

steps.speaker: Restless ghost
steps.text: Oh! It's your amulet that's doing it! I did wonder. I don't suppose you can help me? I don't like being a ghost.

options.text: Yes, ok. Do you know why you're a ghost?

talking-to-the-restless-ghost-talking-to.text: I'm pretty sure it's somewhere in the tower south-west from here. There's a lot of levels to the tower, though. I suppose it might take a little while to find.
